### How we help

A channel on its own cannot carry a practice. Search and AI answers, email, ads, the enquiry that follows: all of it runs as one system or none of it does, each channel feeding the next, because a lead found by search and lost by the follow-up was never really found at all. So we build the lot. The position, the website, the proposals, the CRM, the monthly engine, connected, measured against one number you choose. Where a channel leaks, we score it, rank the fix and report the movement in revenue. Not impressions.

01 / SEO and GEO

### Google vs AI search. Which option is more efficient?

Google’s list still matters, and SEO is how you get on it. GEO, generative engine optimisation, means being a source an AI trusts enough to name.

Semora builds for both. The list and the answer both get measured against the number you agreed to move, and the figures go in your report. Moved or not.

Get your free visibility report → Check out an SEO analysis →

Winning authoritative references

UserConversational, question-based prompts ResultDirectly generated, referenced answer ActionReceive, understand summary, and make decisions FocusStructured data, content entities, and validation SuccessBeing used as a trusted reference

### Diagnose, and rank by cost

### Fix in order

Indexability first, because a page a machine cannot reach earns nothing downstream. Your developer can ship the work, or we can.

Closes on the re-measurement of that row, dated.

Closes on next month, held against this one.

Why it holds

A row closes when the re-measurement says so, and the date goes beside it.

The question wording is fixed before the first run, so a month that moved can be told apart from a month that was asked differently.

Misses stay on the sheet. A scoreboard that hides its zeros cannot be read next month.

A second reader re-runs the checks. What they stop is written into the report rather than quietly repaired.

06 / Questions we get asked

### Frequently asked questions

### What is the difference between SEO and GEO?

SEO earns a place on the list of results. GEO, generative engine optimisation, earns a place inside the generated answer, as a named source. Same buyer, two doors; the second is decided by entity clarity and evidence rather than by links alone.

### Can you guarantee a position in an AI answer?

No. Nobody can. No platform sells one, and an agency that offers one is selling something else. What can be worked is whether you are eligible, whether a machine can resolve your name to one company, and whether there is evidence for it to cite.

### How do you measure AI search visibility?

Sixteen questions your buyer would ask, put to ChatGPT and Perplexity in clean sessions with the wording fixed in advance. Each answer scores 0 to 3: not mentioned, mentioned, cited, recommended. The total is reported monthly, misses included.

### Do you need access to our Search Console?

Yes, before anything starts. Without it an audit is a guess dressed as a diagnosis: we can see what your site is, but not what it earns. Analytics and the business profile follow the same rule.

### What does the first month look like?

Access first: Search Console, analytics, the business profile, and whoever holds the site, all in your name before anything else happens, because an audit without them is a guess dressed as a diagnosis. Then the baseline, written down. Then the four-part audit of platform, speed, indexation and architecture, which produces the fix ledger, sorted by what each fault costs you and closed row by row on re-measurement. Each row has a date. The keyword-to-page map and the question-to-page map come out of the same month. The first report follows the baseline, so the number on its first line has a starting figure beside it and a date under it.

### Do you work with our own developer?

Yes. Technical SEO research and support is built for that: we find the faults, rank them by cost and specify the fix; your team ships it; we re-measure and close the row.

### Which platforms do you optimise for?

Five surfaces: Google’s ranked results and map pack, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Copilot. One body of evidence serves all five; what differs is how each one reads it.

### Is this priced?

Yes, in figures, on the quotation page and the homepage. A quote is arithmetic on published numbers. The budget conversation is already on the page.

Start here

We put your name to the same sixteen questions and email you what came back. It is free. The method is published.

05 / Questions we get asked

### Frequently asked questions

### Who pays the platforms, you or us?

You do, direct. Your card sits on your own Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn accounts and the platform bills you for the media. Our fee is separate and published, so it stays the same whether your budget goes up or down that month.

### Do we own the ad accounts?

Yes. Accounts are opened in your business name and we work inside them with access you grant and can withdraw. If the engagement ends, the campaign history, the audiences and the conversion data stay where they are.

### How much should we spend?

Enough to buy a readable month. A budget that produces two or three conversions gives nobody a signal to act on, which means the first month is spent learning rather than earning. We set the figure against the value of one client to you, and we write down what it has to return before it starts.

### Why does LinkedIn cost more than Google?

Because you are bidding for a named job title rather than for a search, and everyone else who wants that title is in the same auction. LinkedIn publishes no rate card, so the real cost of a click is discovered in your first month rather than quoted in a proposal. It earns its price when one client is worth a great deal and the buying committee is several people.

### Can Google spend more than our daily budget?

On any given day, yes. Google publishes the rule: a campaign can spend up to twice its average daily budget on a busy day, and over a month you are never charged more than 30.4 times that daily average. The monthly figure is the one to budget against. We set daily budgets from the monthly number you signed off, not the other way round.

### Can you guarantee a cost per lead?

No. The auction price moves with your competitors, your season and your own conversion rate, and nobody controls all three. What we commit to is the work, the published quantities, the tracking being correct before money runs, and a report that shows the figure whether it improved or not.

### Is this priced?

Yes, in figures, on the quotation page and the homepage. A quote here is arithmetic on published numbers, and the same numbers go to everyone.

Start here

# What the monthly report looks like &mdash; SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/seo-report-example
Summary: A worked specimen of the monthly SEO report: seven layers scored, two numbers rather than one, the register, and what the second reader stopped. Every figure invented.

Specimen · every figure invented

## The monthly report, opened

This is the shape of the report a client receives, filled with invented figures so you can read the structure without reading anyone’s business, and the failures sit beside the wins for a reason that has more to do with arithmetic than with honesty: by month three somebody has to decide where the next month’s hours go, and a page carrying only good news gives them nothing to decide with. So the weak layers are named. So is the work that has not started, and the items sitting with the client rather than with us.

Reporting period: month three of an engagement · Prepared by SEMORA STUDIO · Reviewed by a second reader, independent of delivery

01 / The judgement

### Seven layers, scored

Each layer scores on what can be shown, rather than on effort spent. A layer scores low when the evidence is missing, even where the work is done. That is the point of scoring it.

Technical foundation92

Keyword system85

Content system65

Conversion tracking60

Crawling and indexing55

Entity recognition45

External authority25

The weakest layer is the one an answer engine reads first. Naming it in month three, in writing, is how it gets fixed by month six. Leaving it out costs a quarter.

02 / The score

### Two numbers, not one

Building the system and getting a commercial result out of it are different things. Averaging them into a single number hides which one you are paying for this month.

72/100

System build. Infrastructure, process gates, and tools a stranger could re-run to check the claim.

62/100

Result readiness. Weighted across the seven layers: how far the system is from being cited by a machine and bringing work in.

Why the second number sits lower: the citation work has not started, the profile verification is outstanding, part of the site waits to be re-crawled, and this month’s visibility run has not been taken, so a claim that things improved would rest on air. We do not make one.

03 / The register

### Every item, and its state

The register is the spine of the engagement. Each row closes on evidence a second reader can re-run. Items waiting on you are marked, so none of them sits in the dark.

ClosedIndexing statusConsole export reconciled against the sitemap; the arithmetic checks out.

ClosedCore Web VitalsHome page lifted from red to green; largest paint cut by two thirds.

ClosedKeyword-to-page mapOne owner page per term, primary and supporting named per cluster.

PartialBuyer question listMapped from research. The real enquiry wording fills in as enquiries arrive.

Your actionBusiness profile verificationOnly the owner can complete it, and it blocks the entity cross-check below.

BlockedEntity cross-checkWaiting on the item above. The site side is already done.

OpenExternal citation programmeThe target list can be drafted here. Sending it is yours to authorise.

OpenFirst visibility benchmarkRuns on the locked protocol, and needs the sessions captured by hand.

04 / The check

### What the second reader stopped

Delivery does not sign off its own work. A second reader re-runs the scripts, samples the register for honesty, and compares the log against the commit history. What they stop is published here.

The closed-item count

The headline count could not be reproduced. The register’s true figures replaced it everywhere.

A published boundary statement

It breached the writing standard. Rewritten, redeployed, confirmed live the same day.

Both were fixed before the report was issued. A month with nothing stopped usually means nobody looked.

05 / Next

### Ordered by what moves most

Verify the business profileUnlocks the entity cross-check and gives the brand terms somewhere to resolve to.

You · 20 minutes

Take the first visibility benchmarkTurns “no number” into a baseline, so next month can be held against something.

Us, with your sign-off

Publish the method page and the decision guidesThe pages answer engines quote most often are the ones explaining how a decision is made.

Us to draft, you to approve

Draft the external citation target listThe list costs nothing. Only sending it earns a citation, and that is your call.

Us to draft

Every figure on this page is invented, and no client’s data appears on it. In a real engagement each number traces to a dated source you can open yourself, and the items waiting on you are named rather than buried.

# Proof Check — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/proof-audit
Summary: The paid diagnostic and the recommended first step. Two weeks, $1,000 + GST, optional, credited in full.

Product 01 / The diagnostic

## Proof Check

You pay for this one, and we recommend starting here. Two sessions of your time: 90 minutes working, then 60 more for the findings, and a written report you own. It is optional. Skip it, and we set your baseline inside Commercial Growth Signal.

$1,0002 weeks · optional · credited in full · + GST

Scope / what you receive

### What do you get for $1,000?

The instrument · All eleven buyer-facing surfaces scored 0–4, with evidence — the same instrument you can run free ·

Your baseline · Win rate · average fee · founder-hours per win ·

Proposal review · Your last five, against the ones that won ·

The field · Three competitors you name, scored on the same instrument ·

The sequence · The three surfaces to fix, in order, and why ·

The findings · 60-minute session, recorded · written report, yours ·

The instrument

### The eleven surfaces, and the question each one answers

Somebody who has a problem they have not told anyone about yet checks these, roughly in this order, before they ever speak to you, and by the time the phone rings most of the checking is already done. You do not see any of it. Each is scored 0–4 with the evidence recorded beside it. Score yourself first, free →

# · Surface · What the buyer is asking ·

01 · First screen · Do these people operate at my level? ·

02 · The enquiry response · How fast, by whom — and did they read what I wrote? ·

03 · The proposal · Is this a document worth keeping? ·

04 · Named results · Has this worked for someone like me, with a number attached? ·

05 · Third-party evidence · Does anyone outside the firm vouch for them? ·

06 · The practitioner's track record · Has this person personally done the thing? ·

07 · Peer proof · Who else in my world already uses them? ·

08 · The fee explanation · Is the price reasoned, or is it a number? ·

09 · What happens after · Do they stay, or hand over and go? ·

10 · The physical impression · The office, the print, the room we meet in. ·

11 · Consistency across all ten · Do I get the same firm every time I look? ·

The order of work

### How long does the Proof Check take, and what do you have to do?

Two weeks, and two and a half hours of your time. You give us two things: the 90-minute working session, and your last five proposals. The 60-minute findings session closes it. Nothing else waits on your team.

Then, in order. We score the eleven surfaces against evidence, and we set your baseline: win rate on qualified enquiries, average fee, founder-hours per win. Then your proposals. Your last five, read against the ones that won. Then the three competitors you name, scored on the same instrument, and if that list is the wrong one, if the firm actually taking your work is not on it, we say so and we say why. Last comes the part you actually wanted: the three surfaces to fix, ranked, with the reason each one sits where it does.

It ends with a 60-minute findings session, recorded, and a written report. The recording and the report are yours.

Why it is paid

### Why does SEMORA STUDIO charge for an audit when others give one away?

Because a free audit is a sales call in a costume, and specialists can tell. Charging makes it an engagement rather than a pitch, and an engagement is the version whose findings you can actually use, because nothing is held back for a proposal at the end. That is the trade. It also filters for people who are actually going to act on them.

You keep the report whether or not you hire us.

The $1,000 is credited in full against any engagement you start within 90 days. Hire us and the audit costs nothing. Walk away and you still hold a scored baseline, and a ranked list of what to fix in what order, which is more than you had on the Monday morning you first picked up the phone to us. That is the deal.

What it is not

### What is the Proof Check not?

Not a strategy, and not a proposal. It measures where you stand. It does not decide your position, write your messaging or build anything, and if you want the audit to hand you a strategy at the end you will be disappointed. That is deliberate. That work is Commercial Growth Signal and Growth Foundation Build, priced separately and published in the same detail.

It is also optional. You can start at Commercial Growth Signal instead and we set the baseline there in week one. The rule underneath all of it is no work without a baseline, because otherwise nobody can say at 120 days whether anything moved. That rule does not bend.

Book the Proof Check Next: Commercial Growth Signal →

# Commercial Growth Signal — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/signal
Summary: What you stand for, to whom, and why it is worth your fee. Four weeks, from $3,000 + GST — core scope plus optional modules.

Product 02 / The position

## Commercial Growth Signal

What you stand for, who it is for, and why it is worth your fee. Two half-days and two reviews of your time. Best entered from the audit. Otherwise we set the baseline in week one.

from $3,0004 weeks · core scope + optional modules · + GST

Scope / what you receive

### What do you get with Commercial Growth Signal?

Deliverable · What it is · What it does commercially ·

The position · Statement + the argument that defends it · The written answer to “why you, at your fee” ·

The proposition & fee logic · What you sell, and the reasoning that holds the price · Read by buyers before they ever ask — ends the discount conversation ·

Message architecture · Promise → idea → position → elevator → service story · Every person in the practice says the same thing ·

The audience optional · +$1,800 · Definition + two personas from your actual client base · Who to say it to, and what they check before buying ·

The objection playbook · Your six objections, answered in your words · Scripted for first calls and proposals — no improvising under pressure ·

The competitive map optional · +$1,000 · Where you sit against named competitors — and where not to go · Stops you marketing into ground you cannot win ·

The number · One agreed metric, set from your baseline · What all following work is accountable to, in the contract ·

The handover · The written document + a 90-minute team session · Repeatable by a new hire without you in the room ·

Core scope is $3,000 fixed. The two optional modules are chosen at kickoff, not mid-engagement.

Why it is priced like this

### Why does Commercial Growth Signal cost $3,000?

Because a position is fee infrastructure, and the $3,000 is measured against what an undefended position costs you in a year. Open last year's client list. Beside each name, write the fee you first quoted and the fee you actually took to win the work. Add up the gap. That is what one undefended year costs you, and the same gap opens again this year, and the year after that, because nothing about the conversation that produced those discounts has changed since the last time you had it. Nobody enjoys that sum. For most practices it is a multiple of this fee. Run it in your own books before you talk to us.

Six objections come up on a first call, and you answer them a different way each time, because nobody ever wrote down the best version. That is the leak. The position, the fee logic and the objection playbook exist to end that discount. Check the arithmetic against your own books. That is the only claim we make for it.

What this is not

### Not a workshop with sticky notes

Hand the document to whoever starts on Monday. On day one they can repeat it correctly, without you in the room. Written down, or it is not a position.

# About SEMORA STUDIO — Melbourne marketing agency
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/about
Summary: SEMORA STUDIO is a Melbourne specialist growth company and marketing agency for commercial industry, owner-led and healthcare practices. Published prices.

About

## What is SEMORA STUDIO?

SEMORA STUDIO is a leading specialist growth company and marketing agency for commercial industry professionals, owner-led businesses, and healthcare and allied-health practices. We combine positioning, digital marketing, AI visibility and conversion systems into clearly defined products with transparent pricing and measurable performance.

01 / Who we work with

### Who does SEMORA STUDIO work with?

Three fields, one condition. Commercial industry professionals — commercial property and the advice around it: agents, asset and property owners, project management, developers and specialist consultants.

Owner-led businesses. Firms with a name on the door and a founder still in the room. The kind whose buyers read everything before they call. Not a startup before its first revenue, and not anyone whose pitch is the cheapest price in the market.

Healthcare and allied health practices. Clinics with more than one practitioner, and the wellness practices beside them. Health advertising is regulated in Australia. So every clinical claim we write is checked against the National Law and against current Ahpra guidance, we write down what backs it, and it does not go live until you have read it and said yes. That is slower. We keep that record so you can produce it. It is not legal advice, and we will tell you when to get some.

The shared condition: your buyers must need to see real clients and real outcomes before they commit. That rules out plenty of good businesses, and we would rather say so on the first call than three months into a retainer you are already paying for. So here it is. If a good story on its own wins your market, we are the wrong firm.

Who we are not for: startups pre-revenue, and anyone competing on lowest price. Narrowness is what lets us know your buyer better than you do. Outside the three fields we take a practice only when the shared condition above holds: its buyers must need to see real clients and real outcomes before they commit.

02 / What we publish that others do not

### Four commitments, in writing

Across 41 Melbourne and Australian firms scored in August 2026, we found none publishing all four. These are the terms, not the marketing.

C1 / Prices

### Every price and delivery time is published

No quote-on-request · the same numbers for every client · see them all →

C2 / The number

### One agreed number, on the record

Set at kickoff from your baseline · reviewed at 120 days · the enforceable clause is in legal drafting

C3 / Ownership

### You own everything, by contract

Source files, design tokens, templates, governance — at completion

C4 / The instrument

### Our instrument is public

The eleven surfaces, free and ungated — score yourself → before you speak to us

03 / The company

### Is SEMORA STUDIO a new company?

Yes — new, and we say so. SEMORA STUDIO works from Central House Toorak, Level 3, 489 Toorak Road, Toorak VIC 3142, Melbourne, with Australian practices. The company began operating in 2026. There is no decade of case studies here and we will not pretend there is. What we publish instead is the thinking, the prices and our own score, zeros included.

How the work gets done: the people listed on the team page, with the work split by function. Research and production are AI-assisted, and we say so rather than let you picture a floor of staff who are not there. Nothing leaves until a person has read it and signed it off.

How we handle claims: named, dated, sourced and caveated. A client quote is published with their name on it and their written yes, or labelled as a sample until a real one replaces it. A claim without a source, a date or a starting number does not ship. Our board is the exception. The cards print the change without the period behind it, so ask and we will take you through any of them.

# Method — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/method
Summary: One agreed number reviewed at 120 days, everything handed over, and our own eleven-surface score published — zeros included.

Method

## Accountable to one number. In writing

A named metric in the contract, everything handed over at completion — and our own instrument applied to us, in public.

### How does SEMORA STUDIO work?

01

### What is the one number SEMORA STUDIO is accountable to?

One metric from your audit baseline — win rate, fee integrity, or founder dependency — reviewed at 120 days, on the record. The full accountability clause is in legal drafting and publishes here when signed off: a commitment before it is enforceable would be a claim we could not evidence.

02

### What do you own at the end of an engagement?

Everything SEMORA STUDIO built for you. Source files, tokens, templates and the written governance model transfer at completion, by contract. SIL OFL fonts — no seat licences. Nothing held hostage to a retainer.

03

### Why hire a marketing agency that has no track record yet?

SEMORA STUDIO is new, and says so, unprompted. What substitutes for tenure: named people, this published method, published prices, and source files that transfer by contract — if we vanished tomorrow, you keep everything.

04 / SEMORA STUDIO vs a traditional marketing agency

### We are a marketing agency. A narrow one

Plenty of agencies are excellent, and many are strategic and integrated. This is not a claim that the category is broken.

The difference is shape. Narrower in who we serve. Broader in what we connect. Every price and every delivery time is already published on this site.

Which should you choose? If you have people who can execute but no direction, a consultant may be enough. If your strategy is settled and you only lack production capacity, a specialist agency will do. We are built for the case in between — no senior marketer in-house, and not enough capacity to run it either. See the four products →

05 / Our own score

### How does SEMORA STUDIO score on its own instrument?

24 of a possible 44, at launch in August 2026, zeros included. It is the same eleven-surface instrument we score clients on and the same one published free at score your practice — eleven surfaces, each scored 0–4, so 44 is the ceiling. The zeros are the honest cost of being new, and the plan for removing them is beside each one. Re-scored quarterly.

01 / Meet the team

### Meet the team

Our team is made up of strategists, creative thinkers and problem-solvers, and each of them owns a discipline outright: search, performance, production or the client relationship, the way a good practice owns its own field. One discipline each. The research and production grunt work behind them is AI-assisted. We say so plainly rather than let you picture a floor of desks that does not exist. It speeds up the reading and the first drafts. Search sits with the person who reads the data, and the page gets built by the person who will answer for it. # Privacy — SEMORA STUDIO Melbourne
URL: https://www.semora.com.au/privacy
Summary: What the enquiry form collects, which four companies handle it, what our host measures, and how to have it corrected or deleted.

Privacy

## What we hold, and what we do with it

You filled in a form. Here is where it goes, who else touches it, and how to get it back.

01 / What the form asks for

### Which fields are required?

Seven of the eight on our contact page. Your name, your practice, your email, your field, what you want built, how you found us, and what prompted the enquiry. Your phone is the optional one. The free visibility report page also asks for your website address, because the report is about that website.

Our server is stricter about three of them and lets the rest through empty: your name, your email, and your message.

The page adds one line you did not type. It holds the site that sent you and the page you landed on, so that when you arrive from a search engine or from a link inside an assistant like ChatGPT, we can tell which channels bring us work instead of guessing at it. It is a hostname and a path. Two short strings. Some hostnames do identify a company, so that line is not always anonymous, and we would rather say so than pretend otherwise.

02 / Where the enquiry goes

### What happens after I press send?

It becomes an email in our inbox. We send you an acknowledgement as well. That second one is best effort: if it does not reach you, your enquiry still reached us.

The form writes to no customer database. An enquiry to SEMORA STUDIO is a message in a mailbox, which is a smaller footprint than most agencies keep and is worth saying plainly.

03 / The Quotation System

### Do you see the package I build?

No. Tick a service and the total changes on your screen. Your browser holds that selection so a reload does not wipe it, and it clears when the browsing session ends. If your browser blocks site data, it is not held at all.

Press Email Quote and your own mail program opens with the quote already written out. You decide whether to send it.

Card payments run on a page Stripe hosts. Your card number goes to them. What comes back to us is the amount, the items, whether the payment cleared, and the contact details Stripe collected at the till.

04 / Cookies and measurement

### Does this site set cookies?

Our own code sets none, so you will not meet a banner here.

Our host runs two small scripts. Between them they record the page, the site that referred you, your country and city, your device, browser and operating system, your network speed and how quickly the page loaded. That is a long list. The traffic one works without cookies by turning each request into a hash so it can count a returning visitor within the same day without storing who that visitor is. Counted, not named. It is a fuller account than most sites print. We would rather give you it than call the whole thing anonymous and leave you to find out.

05 / Who else handles it

### Which companies are involved?

Four, and each does one job. Resend delivers the emails. Google hosts the mailbox they land in. Stripe processes card payments. Vercel serves this website and runs the two scripts above.

Some of them store data outside Australia. We are saying so before you type rather than in a clause you find later.

We do not sell it.

06 / Getting it back

### How do I see or delete what you hold?

Email team@semora.com.au and ask. A person here reads it, tells you what we hold, and corrects or deletes what we are free to change.

Records that belong to a payment stay longer, because Australian tax law generally requires a company to keep them for five years.

If our answer does not satisfy you, the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner takes privacy complaints at oaic.gov.au. Tell us first. We would rather fix it than read about it.
